question: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route.
sql:
SELECT 
    t.trip_headsign,
    MIN(st1.departure_time) AS earliest_clay_departure,
    MAX(st2.arrival_time) AS latest_sac_arrival
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st1
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st2 
    ON st1.trip_id = st2.trip_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t
    ON CAST(st1.trip_id AS STRING) = t.trip_id
WHERE st1.stop_id = 14015
  AND st2.stop_id = 16294
  AND st1.stop_sequence < st2.stop_sequence
GROUP BY t.trip_headsign
ORDER BY t.trip_headsign
